sentences.text: For a dual/special rate loan, the pre-payment-charge rules apply by looking at whether the loan is on floating rate at the time of pre-payment.

If it is floating at the time of pre-payment, the team should then use the floating-rate pre-payment directions in the applicable paragraphs for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, including the no-charge rules and the approved-policy rule where those exceptions do not apply.
The evidence does not provide the loan’s sanction date, borrower type, purpose, or sanctioned amount/limit, so I cannot determine which specific pre-payment paragraph applies to this case.
